name: olens_batching
notes: value = top-1 agreement of teacher-forced next-token argmax, batched (all n in one forward, right-padded) vs one at a time, over the positions predicting each one-at-a-time greedy continuation. Passing also requires every batched greedy token sequence to equal the one-at-a-time one, and its decoded text to equal the vendored wsbench OLens.read run greedily on the same activation
